intro: What kinds of leave your institute grants, and how much of each an employee gets. Requests and balances both read this configuration, so a change here affects future accruals and approvals — never leave that has already been approved.
typesTabIntro: The kinds of leave themselves — their rules, not their quota. Codes are what balances and payroll match on, so treat them as identifiers rather than labels.

emptyTypes.title: No leave types yet
emptyTypes.description: Start with the leave you actually grant — casual, sick and earned leave are the usual three. Unpaid leave is worth adding too: payroll treats it as loss of pay.

policiesTabIntro: How much of each leave type an employee gets, and on what rhythm the scheduled accrual credits it. A leave type with no active policy grants nobody anything.

emptyPolicies.title: No policies yet
emptyPolicies.descriptionNoTypes: Create a leave type first — a policy has to attach to one.
emptyPolicies.description: Give each leave type a quota and an accrual rhythm. Until then the accrual run has nothing to credit.
